_readme: External references for `npm run visual:ref` (scripts/visual-ref.mjs; workflow in .claude/skills/noon-ui/references/verify.md). Every PNG here is exported from Figma or captured from the real app, never from the kit. Entry: name, file, source (origin + export date YYYY-MM-DD), route (+ query), select (CSS selectors whose union box is captured), viewport (the reference's screen width in CSS px; the phone is rendered at it), optional viewportHeight, scale (PNG px per CSS px; the capture's deviceScaleFactor), optional refCrop [x, y, w, h] (PNG px) and masks [[x, y, w, h], ...] (CSS px of the cropped reference; only data that legitimately differs: prices, counts, timers), optional refPosition [x, y] (where the element sits in the reference screen, CSS px; enables the position delta), optional scrollTo (top | <y> | bottom | el:<selector>) and steps ([{click}, {type}, {wait}, {scroll}, {press}]) before the capture, wait (extra settle ms), allowMultiple (selectors may match several elements), optional checks [{ name, selector, expect: { x, y, width, height, right, bottom } (CSS px in the screen, read from the reference), tolerance, sticky: <scroll y> (box must not move after scrolling), source }], and any key of `defaults` to override it: threshold (PASS when the share of differing pixels is at most this), failThreshold (FAIL above; default threshold x failFactor; in between NEEDS-REVIEW), sizeTolerance / failSizeTolerance (px; geometry PASS / FAIL limits, NEEDS-REVIEW in between), positionTolerance (px, checks), channelTolerance (per-channel delta that still counts as the same pixel), cell (px, worst-cell grid), regionShare (a cell is 'hot' above this), maxMaskedShare (more masked than this is NEEDS-REVIEW), acceptSlack (a recorded review still applies while the diff grows by at most this). `review` is written by `node scripts/visual-ref.mjs --accept <name> --by <who> --note <why>` after a human looked; it is pinned to the reference file's hash.
